name: Discord
description: A Discord thread per agent with live status, final answers and diff stats; alerts; Approve/Deny buttons for permission requests; and /frogg slash commands to start, stop and message agents.
author: Frogg

commands.title: Discord: reconnect
commands.description: Reconnect the Discord bot with the current settings

settings.title: Bot token
settings.description: Developer Portal → your application → Bot → Reset Token.

settings.title: Server ID
settings.description: The one Discord server this host is bound to (right-click the server → Copy Server ID, with Developer Mode on).

settings.title: Agents channel ID
settings.description: Text or forum channel that gets one thread per agent. Commands work here and in its threads.

settings.title: Allowed Discord user IDs
settings.description: Comma-separated. Only these users can run /frogg, press buttons or message agents. Empty means nobody.

settings.title: Extra command channel IDs
settings.description: Comma-separated channels (besides the agents channel) where /frogg is accepted.

settings.title: Ping on alerts
settings.description: Comma-separated user IDs pinged when an agent finishes, errors or asks for permission.

settings.title: Ping even while I'm in the app
settings.description: Off: like push notifications, no ping while a Frogg app is in active use (the thread still updates).

settings.title: Read thread messages
settings.description: Forward plain messages in an agent's thread to the agent. Needs the privileged Message Content intent; otherwise use /frogg reply.

settings.title: Show tool calls
settings.description: List each turn's tool calls in its progress message.

settings.title: Show agent count as bot status
